input: I grew up near the sea, collect mechanical keyboards, and spent last weekend repainting my kitchen. My brother has a golden retriever named Pixel. The actual task: compare hosted status-page services for our B2B SaaS. We need a shortlist of three options that support a custom domain, private subscriber groups, Slack incident updates, and EU data residency. Keep the software cost below €150 per month. The recommendation is for our head of engineering.
